notes: The two «ح» branches meet at «الزهري»; the names written after him (سعيد and عباد بن تميم, then «عمه») are the shared tail (rule 3).
«- يعني ابن المسيب -» and «- وهو عبد الله بن زيد -» are editor's glosses: left out. So «عمه» is named only by relation in the text; the Companion's name is in the gloss.
«شكي إلى النبي» is the saying, reported by عمه; the Prophet is the end.
